Night a short update for new travelers
With that in mind

Travelers, please read this quick note from the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.

Pet travel is going smoothly, and we want every trip to feel calm from check-in to arrival. Please keep your contact details current, share any special care needs early, and let us know if your pet is shy, excitable, or needs extra comfort. That helps us match the plan to the animal, not just the booking.

We also ask for prompt, respectful messages so the team can respond without delay. Clear details about feeding, rest habits, carriers, and handling notes make a real difference for the comfort and safety of the pet in our care. If you are traveling with a pet like Ziggy, or planning a first journey with us, the desk can guide you through the usual steps with care.

If you need help, please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
